function.name: move_to
function.arguments: {"targets": {"x": -0.1, "gripper": 0.5}, "note": "Fixed-view triangulation puts the base at negative x and the block further out in +x than my gripper, so I make a clean single-axis +x move of 5 cm (y and z unchanged) to test that: the block should slide toward the wrist-image centre. The intermediate 0.5 gripper target is in the latch-hold band so the already-open fingers stay open while the tool layer spends many control steps on the move."}
